description: Port the public 9.956-LB kernel build_well() feature factory into our pipeline. This is the HIGHEST-VALUE work because the kernel achieves <10 RMSE on LB. Build all 200+ features per row: particle filter on ANCC formation, 7 beam search paths through typewell GR (Numba JIT, allow ±2 lag), multi-scale NCC at hws=(8,15,25) + score-weighted ensemble, per-formation b_well segment anchors (full/early/mid/late/WLS), KNN imputation of formation depths and dense ANCC from neighboring wells, plus all GR rolling/lag/lead/diff/envelope/energy features and TVT-anchor GR offset features (tda/tdbc/tdsc/tdpf). TARGET: delta_target = TVT - last_known_TVT. Reference notebook attached.
features_to_add: tda{offset} (11 offsets relative to last_known TVT)
implementation_notes: READ /tmp/kaggle_better/rogii-better-solution-lb-9-956.ipynb FIRST — port build_well() and helper functions (run_pf_ancc/run_pf_z/beam_search/multi_scale_ncc/FormationPlaneKNN/DenseANCCImputer) verbatim except adapt paths.
Use Numba @njit for beam search and particle filter — Python loops over 773 wells × 1000s of rows = unacceptable.
Target = TVT - last_known_TVT (delta from heel). Predict only on lateral rows (TVT_input is NaN). Reconstruct absolute TVT = last_known + pred.
Train 3 LightGBM (seeds 42/7/123, lrs 0.025/0.020/0.030) + 3 CatBoost (same seeds, depth=7, iterations=8000).
5-fold GroupKFold by well_id. Save raw OOF and test predictions in original CSV row order (length 5092255 train, 19221 test).
Apply per-well savgol(17,3) smoothing as the kernel does for test predictions. Output savgol-smoothed predictions to oof_path/test_path; raw to *_raw.npy.
Use task_type='GPU' for both LGBM and CatBoost.
Target: <12 RMSE. Even 12 is a 3x improvement over our current 29.5. The kernel hits ~10 on LB so we should be close to that on CV.
